notes.title: New Release! Get ZHive for $1.79 (-40%)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone

We have launched another wallet friendly game...Zhive!

Zhive is a small and simple strategy game where you command the undead on the map by selecting the areas where you want them to spawn and then direct them to a target area. But be careful, think strategically. The soldiers are well equipped and can decimate your minions with ease. Don't let them roam around, they could restock and find the survivor!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119530/ZHIVE/

notes.title: UPDATE #6 & 70% OFF
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/f804027cd8e2b4f9de580356febabefcd9f13cc6.gif

Visceral Cubes 1.2.0 is now online.

Hello.

Here we bring you an update on which we fix a couple small bugs and make some preparations for the next dlc (which is free).

In "EXTRACTION" we'll play as a soldier that, along his team, arrives at the facility to secure the Vial and burn the place to the ground. Armed with proper weapons, our new protagonist will face evolved visceral guys with ranged attacks. We hope you enjoy this action oriented campaign.

Now, into the content of this update.

Fixes and Tweaks

Invert Y Axis. The mouse Y axis can now be inverted at the options menu.
Collision Fixes. Fixed a couple areas in the map where collision was glitchy.
DLC Menu Tweaks. Added coming soon buttons for the upcoming DLC.
FullScreen Fix. Fixed a bug where the fullscreen setting was not being saved.
Performance Improvements. A few areas will have improved framerate.
Rear Cam. The rear cam was disabled on the last dlc.  
Skins Fix. Fixed a bug where the enemy skins were not being randomized on the dlc.
Chase Music Fix. Fixed a bug where the chase music kept playing after all enemies died.
Enemy Detection. The enemy "senses" have been slightly re-adjusted.
Distorted SFX fix. Fixed a random bug where the splatter sound was being distorted.
DLC Preparations. Small adjustments on the game code in preparation for the next two dlc.

As always thanks for playing, Look forward to the next dlc :)

notes.title: SUMMER SALE 66% OFF! & UPDATE #4
notes.notes:
Visceral Cubes 1.1.11 is now online! 

Hello Everyone

We hope you are enjoying summer sale. Visceral Cubes will be 66% off during the sale and for players that have already finished the game, there are a couple new things that you may want to check out.

New Stuff and Fixes

FlareGun. This new weapon can be used to shoot your enemies resulting in... an explosion of course. Be careful using it at close range, remember that enemies exploding close to you can kill you. Also the flare needs some momentum before it can make the enemies explode. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/485ce76dab66fbebf077d898d73bbcf6d1704b6d.gif

Incendiary Grenade. It has a shorter range than the flare gun, however it can be used to block certain areas. For example, a door or a bridge. Enemies touching the flames will explode. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/7b404ea9d689b257d64c107bc972bf84b3e19882.gif

Sound Detection Range. When pressing C, you'll be able to see how far the enemies can hear you. Very useful to sneak around. Keep in mind that while you are not crouching with C, the enemies have a larger detection range. Also, if you get in front of their sigh they will still see you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/8315c3aede67199a8bab0c989d481959b6af35bb.gif

More Enemy Animations. There are now several running and walking for the enemies. Ones may run towards you, others may crawl etc 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/b7cfaa623db1e5294372430700b7c0bc9ef8ce58.gif

Several Bug Fixes. Most notably, the bug were the game could be save during the game over screen.

New pickups. Flares and incendiary grenades have been places around the map.

Small Level Design Changes.




Incoming New stuff and fixes

 First DLC
 More bug fixes



Word from the devs
We hope you all enjoy the Steam Summer Sale and that you get enough games for this life and the next!

As always thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #2 - Hard Difficulty Now Available!
notes.notes:
Visceral Cubes 1.1.10 is now online! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32583491/9742a63d1fb52a7d37df14d8d37c98299b777dd0.gif

Hard difficulty now available!
You can now play the game on hard difficulty, which will increase the number of enemies, speed and area of detection. We encourage you to use stealth by moving while crouching and look for the new medkit pickups so you can take more explosions. In this mode, a new section of the station is also available.

Other fixes and new Stuff

Rear Cam. When the player is being chased, a rear cam will now be activated to help the player keep better track of the enemies. The rear cam can be deactivated via the pause menu.

 Medkit Pickup. A new pickup is now scattered on the station, it will raise your health up to 300 HP. This will enable you to survive one direct explosion for 150 DMG. But you won't survive another one. 

 More Documents. New leftover docs will give a bit more context to the game world a well as well as serve as hints for the "tasks" in the new section of the station.

 Performance Improvements. The frame rate should be higher at certain areas, specially at the lab.

 Difficulty Balancing. Depending on which difficulty you choose to play on, the enemies will be faster and their detection ratio larger.

 Crouching Improvements. Moving while crouching will now reduce the chances of being detected. If you plan to get near an enemy, crouch... careful, if you are close enough, you'll get detected as soon as you stand up.

 Pickup sounds. Wherever you pick a medkit, key or toy, you will now hear a sound.

 Timescale Bug Fix. A rare bug where the game froze after reloading the scene was fixed.

 AI Path-finding refinements. The AI is now more accurate at the time of chasing the player. The enemies are harder to shake off. 

 New Doc Container. A new blue container has been implemented, the old black one didn't look well in certain dark areas.




Incoming New stuff and fixes

 First DLC
 Speed Run Mode
 More bug fixes



Word from the devs
We are looking for ways to show the detection ratio of the enemies to further improve the gameplay. 

Also, we want to apologize for the long time it took us to update the game with this new content, from time to time we get a streak of bad luck, in this case it was in the form of some power outages that damaged some of the equipment used to develop/test our games.

We will be running a giveaway soon as compensation. Join  our group   so you don't miss it! 

Don't forget to drop us a review to help the new content going.

As always thank you for your support!

Thanks!
